QDi.437 Name: 1: SAMI 2: JASIM 3: MUHAMMAD DEFENDANTS

a.k.a.: a) Mustafa Adnan al-Aziz) b) Mustafa Adnan al-Azeez c) Sami al-Ajuz d) Hajji

QDi.438 Name 2: ABD EL HAMID 2: SALIM 3: IBRAHIM BRUKAN 4: AL-KHATOUNI
a.k.a a) Abu Omar Al Sarraf
ORDER
BEFORE: The Most Honourable Mr Justice Leslie Haynes, FB, Chief Justice, who
considered the Application on the 31st day of March 2026.
ENTERED on the 27th day of March 2026.
UPON HEARING Counsel for the Claimant Ms. Maya Kellman, State Counsel (Ag.),
Attorney-at-Law for the Claimant;
AND UPON READING the Claim Form fi led on the 27th day of March 2026 and
the supporting affi davit of Ms. Maya Kellman, State Counsel (Ag.) in the Offi ce of
the Director of Public Prosecutions, sworn and fi led on the 31st day of March 2026
together with the Exhibits attached thereto;
AND UPON DETERMINING that this matter be deemed fi t for an urgent hearing;
April 9, 2026 OFFICIAL GAZETTE 3
No. HC0008/2026 – Cont'd
IT IS HEREBY ORDERED that;
1. Pursuant to section 8(1)(a) and section 10A(1) of the Act the Defendants be
declared as listed persons for the purposes of the Act;
2. A Counter Proliferation Order be made against the Defendants QDi.437: SAMI
2: JASIM 3: MUHAMMAD JAATA 4: AL-JABURI a.k.a.: a) Mustafa
Adnan al-Aziz) b) Mustafa Adnan al-Azeez c) Sami al-Ajuz d) Hajji Hamid
and QDi.438 ABD EL HAMID 2: SALIM 3: IBRAHIM BRUKAN 4: AL-
KHATOUNI a.k.a a) Abu Omar Al Sarraf pursuant to section 10B of the Act;
3. A Restraining Order pursuant to sections 8(3)(a) and (4) of the Anti-Terrorism
(Amendment) Act and section 54 of the Proceeds and Instrumentalities of
Crime Act be made against the Defendants to freeze any:
i. property of the Defendants;
ii. property that is wholly or jointly owned or controlled, directly or
indirectly, by the Defendants;
iii. property of any nature whatsoever whether movable or immovable
that is derived or generated from other property owned or
controlled, directly or indirectly, by the Defendants;
iv. property of a person acting on behalf of, or at the direction of, the
Defendants,
v. pursuant to section 8 (3) (b) of the Act that the Defendants be
prohibited from directly or indirectly possessing, controlling or
having access to any property;
4. The Claimant serve a Certifi ed Copy of the Order on the Financial Intelligence
Unit (FIU) immediately;
5. The Court dispense with the requirement for service on the Defendants of the
Declaratory Order and the Counter Proliferation Order
6. Pursuant to section 10(1) of the Act, the Claimant cause a copy of the Order,
to be immediately published electronically and to be published in the Offi cial
Gazette and at least two (2) daily newspapers in circulation in Barbados, as soon
as possible.
7. costs to be costs in the cause;
8. liberty to apply.
Dated this 31st day of March 2026.
IRENE STEPHNEY
Deputy Registrar of the Supreme Court.
